subject: Exclusive Summer Sale Starts Now!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to announce that our exclusive summer sale has officially begun! Enjoy up to 50% off on select items, including summer essentials like swimwear, sandals, and accessories. Don't miss this opportunity to refresh your wardrobe and save big. Visit our store or shop online to explore the incredible deals. Hurry, as stocks are limited. Happy shopping! Best regards, The Sales Team
